programs.title: Midsomer Murders
programs.desc: Another season of the series taking place in England, in Midsomer and its surroundings.Among the eccentric residents there are Chief Inspector Tom Barnaby (John Nettles), calm and persistent in tracking down crimes, husband Joyce (Jane Wymark) and father Cully (Laura Howard).He is assisted by his assistant, Ben Jones (Jason Hughes).Both detectives solve complicated murder cases that take place in the area.What they learn while conducting investigations sometimes exceeds their wildest expectations.
